title: PeerJmapHandler typed Identity parameter prevents auth bypass at compile time
description: The PeerJmapHandler trait takes caller: Identity as a typed parameter rather than extracting it from a JSON field inside each handler. This makes it structurally impossible for a handler implementation to forget to validate the caller identity — the compiler requires the parameter to be present. A contributor might suggest reverting to JSON extraction (simpler trait signature); this would reintroduce the class of bug fixed in KITH-d6l6.1 (forgetting _caller_identity extraction). The compile-time guarantee is load-bearing.
